no_canonical_section: a free positive calibration torsor has no distinguished point from dimensionless invariant data alone
theorem: Calibration choices over observer layers form a principal (R_+)^3 torsor. Dimensionless ratios are invariant under its action; absolute length, time, and energy transform with nonzero weights. Layer-transition maps obey a multiplicative cocycle law. Because the action is free, invariant dimensionless FIN data cannot select a canonical global section. At least one dimensional anchor per independent unit direction, or relations reducing the structure group, remains necessary.
